tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 12 - the wait-stage split. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - measured across rounds 9-11: the single wait node n_goal_response carries ~11 outbound semantic edges plus a 3,600-char offer-bearing prompt, and Bland's edge router INTERMITTENTLY abstains under that load - the same message ('Tuesday the 18th') routed correctly as one turn and fabricated 2020-dated offers on another in the same run. No label wording fixes a reliability ceiling. Production v96 never exhibits this because it splits the waiting role: a pre-offer ask node with few edges and NO offer copy, and a post-offer node with sharply disjoint edges. THE FIX - copy every artifact from /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD14/gl-round11-fix/ into CWD and restructure: (1) ADD user-wait Default node n_goal_ask (pre-offer stage): its prompt carries the opening copy (the greeting currently in n_goal_response's opening path moves here verbatim), the when-would-you-like ask, the miss/clarify handling for zero-result and out-of-hours searches (reference {{requested_clock}} for the out-of-hours branch), and NO slot templates whatsoever - this node must be physically unable to speak an offer; prompt at most 2,200 characters. It carries the full frozen extractor set verbatim (frozen-extractors.json unchanged, byte-identical). Entry wiring: whatever currently routes conversation start into n_goal_response (identity/appt-check chain) routes into n_goal_ask instead. (2) n_goal_ask outbound edges, AT MOST 6: to n_goal_search with the full proven enumeration label from round 11 (day/weekday/date/week/weekend/time preference including the agreement-phrased '3pm works for me' example); to n_goal_search_latest labeled 'wants late, latest, last appointment, or end of day'; to n_goal_search_anchor labeled 'asks for a time near, around, or close to a specific clock time'; to e_declined; to e_timeout. (3) n_goal_response becomes the post-offer stage, AT MOST 8 outbound edges: n_gate_1 and n_gate_2 (existing clock-time-hardened labels), n_mixed_intent (existing label), n_goal_search_offered_time and n_goal_search_offered_latest (keep their offer-conditioned labels), n_goal_search labeled 'states a NEW day, date, week, or time preference different from the offered date', e_declined, e_timeout. Remove the generic-latest and anchor edges from n_goal_response (post-offer latest goes through offered_latest; a post-offer named-day-latest flows through the new-preference search). Its prompt keeps the offer template, gates copy, and out_of_hours branch, still at most 3,900 characters; remove the opening copy that moved to n_goal_ask. (4) SEARCH responsePathways: every availability webhook's success path (count >= 1) targets n_goal_response (offers are spoken there); zero-result, error, and out_of_hours-true paths target n_goal_ask (the honest miss/re-ask lives pre-offer where no fabrication is possible). Keep executable conditions. (5) The date-conflict nodes, mixed-intent, gates, verifies, books, per-branch confirms, suppression/end nodes, extractors, and all webhook bodies stay untouched except where edges above require retargeting. Every user-wait feeder of any availability webhook still carries the frozen extractors (n_date_conflict family already does). (6) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 12 keeping 1-11 intact: n_goal_ask exists as user-wait Default with the frozen extractors, no slot templates in its prompt, and at most 6 outbound edges; n_goal_response has at most 8; the none-search enumeration edge originates at n_goal_ask; every availability webhook's success pathway reaches n_goal_response and its miss/out-of-hours pathway reaches n_goal_ask. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 12'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-11 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD14/gl-round11-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing assertion 12. (7) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated for all twelve assertions. (8) DEBUG.md: the intermittent-router evidence, the split design, what moved where, regeneration command.
tasks.verified: The wait role is split into a pre-offer ask node that cannot fabricate offers (no slot templates, max 6 edges) and a post-offer response node (max 8 disjoint edges), with search successes landing on the offer stage and misses on the ask stage - proven by the twelve-assertion validator, rejection of the round-11 draft, and the independent structural check.
